barriers.reason: The 8:00 AM weekday DOT time conflicts with the patient's work van pickup at 6:00 AM; missing work means losing a full day's pay, so weekday 8 AM visits are hard to sustain for 8 weeks.
The patient relies on a work van that leaves at 6:00 AM on Lawrence and has no described separate way to reach the clinic by 8:00 AM without missing work.

alternatives.text: Ask the TB clinic for a later weekday appointment time or a fixed day that fits after the work van route, to avoid losing a day's pay.
Use video-observed doses via the patient's existing smartphone/WhatsApp for some doses, since the patient already uses it daily with family.
Cluster any required in-person visits on the same day/campus to minimize separate trips and lost work days.

barriers.reason: Monthly labs are tied to DOT encounters at 8:00 AM weekdays, which conflict with the 6:00 AM work van and lost pay.
Each lab draw requires an additional clinic trip the patient may not be able to make without missing work.

alternatives.text: Schedule the monthly lab draw on the same day as a scheduled DOT encounter and request a time after the morning work van.
Ask whether sputum can be collected at a more convenient site/time or combined with other visits to reduce trips.
Confirm the exact lab schedule with the TB program social worker so it fits the patient's work days.
